verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference portal, a docs MCP server that can query the API reference, and an llms.txt content index. None of these is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec: llms.txt and the docs MCP are adjacent AI-readable documentation aids, not an API specification file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
